name: Epex Home | Solar Works Energy
about:
Solar Works Energy operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico, serving residential customers across New Mexico, Colorado, and Texas. The company focuses on designing and installing rooftop and ground-mounted solar photovoltaic systems for homeowners seeking to reduce electricity costs.

The installation process follows six steps: an initial consultation to assess feasibility, a site survey to evaluate energy needs, engineering design and permitting handled by in-house engineers, installation by trained crews, system activation for immediate savings, and a referral program that rewards customers with $250 per converted referral. The company advertises $0 down financing with no upfront installation fees.

Its primary market is homeowners in the Southwest looking to lock in predictable energy rates amid rising utility costs. The company cites an average post-installation monthly bill of $10.51 and notes that the local utility PNM has increased rates 12% over six years. Customer acquisition relies on direct consultation and word-of-mouth referrals.

Solar Works Energy states its mission is to educate the public on saving money while reducing dependence on fossil fuels. It emphasizes a hands-on approach with dedicated consultants and installers, backed by over 215 Google reviews averaging 4.6 stars.

name: Epic Wood Work
old_description: We are general contractors who emphasize on custom cabinet making and design.
about:
Epic Wood Work operates from Irving, Texas, as a general contracting firm with a focus on custom cabinet making and design. The company is led by owner Pepe Gamarra and lead designer and project manager Karla Mireles.

The firm provides full kitchen and bathroom remodels alongside bespoke millwork and cabinetry. Its services span demolition, design, and fabrication of custom cabinets, wall moldings, barn doors, board-and-batten walls and ceilings, paneled walnut details, and fluted finishes. The team manages projects from initial demo through final installation.

Epic Wood Work serves residential clients undertaking kitchen and bath renovations or seeking custom woodwork for interiors. Testimonials from homeowners such as Steve Eldridge and Devin Madsen highlight the company's work on major remodels where specific visions were executed with attention to detail and transparent budgeting.

The company positions itself as a one-stop shop for remodeling needs, emphasizing end-to-end project management, clear communication, and on-time delivery without hidden costs.

about:
Equipment Blades Inc. operates from La Vista, Nebraska, as a U.S.-owned manufacturer of heavy‑equipment wear components. The company does not disclose a founding year or founder names in its public materials, but emphasizes that its products are made in the USA and tariff‑free.

The shop produces custom Hardox® cutting edges, wear parts, and snow‑plow blades for motor graders, wheel loaders, excavators, skid steers, and similar machinery. It also supplies the SHARQ EDGES quick‑change system and carbide‑tipped grader blades. A fully stocked warehouse supports same‑week shipping on many Hardox® items, with general lead times quoted at two to ten days.

Customers span heavy construction, agriculture and dairy, landscaping and turf management, and municipal snow removal. Specific applications include feed pushers and cow‑monitoring automation for dairies, commercial mowers and line‑painting equipment for turf crews, and undercarriage parts, digging buckets, and fleet attachments for earthmoving fleets.

Equipment Blades differentiates itself through its exclusive membership in the Hardox® Wearparts worldwide network, which guarantees material traceability and extended wear life. The company also highlights competitive pricing, a measurement‑assist service for correct part identification, and the lightweight SHARQ EDGES technology that allows blade changes without heavy tools.

name: Erdman Auto Parts
old_description: Maryland Junkyards – Parts, Salvage, Towing, Repair, Recycling
about:
Based in Baltimore, Maryland, Maryland Junkyards has operated for more than three decades as a network of five salvage yards across the state. The company's locations include Erdman Auto Parts on Erdman Avenue in Baltimore, Redmonds Auto Parts in Pasadena, Marty's Auto Parts on Hollins Ferry Road, A-1 Auto Sales in Havre de Grace, and Stokes Auto Parts in Jefferson.

The business centers on used auto parts, automotive repair, towing, and vehicle recycling. Across its five facilities, the company stocks millions of parts covering most makes and models of cars and trucks, and offers installation services. Each year it recycles approximately 75,000 gallons of gasoline recovered from salvaged vehicles, using the filtered fuel in its own fleet and converting engine oils, transmission fluids, and gear lubricants to heat its warehouses; the remaining hulks are shredded for steel.

Customers range from individual vehicle owners seeking affordable replacement parts to repair shops needing specific components. The company buys junk vehicles directly from the public, providing free towing and cash on the spot, and also sells parts nationally through its eBay storefront. Its repair bays handle general automotive service for walk-in clients.

Maryland Junkyards emphasizes a one-stop-shop model: parts come with a limited replacement warranty, including lifetime coverage on alternators, starters, wiper motors, and heater blower motors, while engines and transmissions carry a minimum 30-day guarantee. The operation's recycling loop — reusing fluids and fuel on-site — is presented as both a cost saving and an environmental commitment.

name: Ethical Energy Solar
old_description: Begin securing your future while lowering your expenses with our solar solutions, all available for $0 upfront cost.
about:
Ethical Energy Solar is a locally owned and operated solar energy installation company headquartered in York, Pennsylvania, with a second office in Pittsburgh. The company serves residential customers across Pennsylvania, Maryland, and Delaware, helping homeowners transition to solar power with no upfront cost through lease and power purchase agreements.

The firm provides end-to-end solar services, including system design, engineering, permitting, utility paperwork, and HOA approvals. Its certified installation crews typically complete residential projects in one to three days. In addition to solar panel arrays, Ethical Energy installs Tesla PowerWall battery backup systems and offers roofing services to prepare homes for solar installation. The company reports having helped thousands of homeowners qualify for zero-out-of-pocket solar since its inception.

Ethical Energy focuses exclusively on the residential market, working with homeowners who want to reduce electricity bills, earn income through Pennsylvania's SREC program, and increase property value. The company's portfolio includes projects tailored to each roof's angle, orientation, and shading conditions, and it manages all administrative steps from incentive calculation to grid interconnection.

The company differentiates itself with a 25-year performance guarantee on all products and services, framing the guarantee as an ethical commitment rather than a standard warranty. Its stated mission is to empower people by providing clean, affordable power while creating career opportunities and building a more sustainable American economy.

name: Eureka Manufacturing Co
old_description: is a leading provider of made-to-order steel and stainless steel fabrications for the commercial aquatics industry. We specialize in:
about:
Eureka Manufacturing Co. was founded in 1988 in Eureka, South Dakota. The company operates from a facility at 402 B Ave in Eureka, with a mailing address in Bismarck, North Dakota.

The company specializes in made-to-order steel and stainless steel fabrications for the commercial aquatics industry. Its capabilities include custom design, engineering, and fabrication of pool components such as movable swimming pool bulkheads, perimeter recirculation systems (gutters), swimming pool filters, anti-entrapment drain covers, sumps, access ramps, and water treatment systems. The shop also produces custom artistic metalwork and agricultural silos. To date, the firm has completed over 5,000 projects for more than 2,500 clients.

Eureka Manufacturing serves commercial aquatic facilities across the United States, Canadian provinces, Taiwan, and the Middle East. Its products are installed in public and commercial pools that must comply with the Virginia Graeme Baker Pool & Spa Safety Act.

The company emphasizes safety and quality by design, noting that its anti-entrapment drain covers are certified and stocked for immediate shipment. It also highlights a commitment to custom solutions and long-term client relationships.

name: EverGreen Sheet Metal, Inc.
old_description: If it’s made of metal, we are very likely able to design, fabricate, and install it.
about:
EverGreen Sheet Metal, Inc. was founded in 1986 by Donald Green in New Bedford, Massachusetts. The family-owned, union sheet metal shop sits on the city's waterfront. Donald's son, Charlie Green, joined the business after graduating from Massachusetts Maritime Academy and assumed leadership in 2019 following his father's retirement.

The company designs, fabricates, and installs custom sheet metal products. Its capabilities include water jet cutting at 55,000 PSI, along with traditional sheet metal forming and assembly. The shop serves a range of project sizes, from one-off architectural reproductions to production runs of specialized equipment such as automated parts cooling units.

EverGreen works across industrial, marine, medical, and residential sectors. Medical projects have included instrument wash baskets and HVAC return grilles. The firm also produces antique architectural reproductions and serves marine and industrial clients with custom fabrications.

The company emphasizes a nearly 40-year tradition of detail-oriented craftsmanship, a union-trained workforce from Sheet Metal Workers' Local 17, and membership in SMACNA. Green founded the business to provide honest communication and quality craftsmanship, values that continue under second-generation ownership.

about:
EverGuard Solar was founded in 2008 in Albuquerque, New Mexico, as a family-owned solar installation and design company. The business began with a focus on serving New Mexico communities using local labor and regional expertise, and it has remained locally operated without outsourcing to out-of-state contractors.

The company designs and installs photovoltaic systems for residential, commercial, government, and industrial customers across the Albuquerque–Santa Fe metro area and beyond, including Rio Rancho, Los Lunas, Santa Fe, and Los Alamos. Its services cover grid-tied solar arrays, off-grid installations with battery storage, and assistance with financing options such as loans, leases, and power purchase agreements. EverGuard also helps clients navigate federal tax credits and state incentives to reduce upfront costs.

Customers range from homeowners seeking to lower electricity bills to commercial property owners, municipal facilities, and industrial sites looking for energy independence. The installer works with monocrystalline solar panels and offers battery systems for backup power, tailoring each project to the specific energy demands and roof conditions of the site.

EverGuard emphasizes its local dedication, stating that systems are built to meet the environmental demands of the Southwest and that every project is handled by New Mexican crews. The company cites a commitment to quality, craftsmanship, and customer satisfaction as the foundation of its decade-plus track record in the region.

about:
Everlight Solar is based in La Vista, Nebraska. The founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. The company focuses on residential solar panel installation, offering a full-service approach from permitting to system activation.

The company provides turnkey solar installation for homeowners, handling permit acquisition, panel mounting, electrical interconnection, and system monitoring. Everlight supplies the solar panels and coordinates the entire installation process with no upfront cost to the customer. Each system is backed by a 25-year warranty that includes ongoing performance monitoring.

Everlight serves residential customers seeking to replace utility electricity with owned solar generation. The company operates in multiple markets, including Wisconsin where it has received recognition such as the South Central Wisconsin Best of the Best Winner and Best of Madison Winner in Solar Energy.

Everlight differentiates itself through a simplified, hassle-free process and a commitment to workforce development, evidenced by its NCCER certification for training programs. The company also runs a national Clean Energy Scholarship program for students.

name: Evermade Foods
old_description: We help ambitious creators bring unique, innovative food products to the world.
about:
Evermade Foods operates from Warrenton, Virginia, in the Northern Virginia corridor. The company is led by a leadership team with over 20 years of culinary product manufacturing experience, though a specific founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. The business was established to help ambitious creators bring unique, innovative food products to market through dedicated co-manufacturing.

The company produces fresh and frozen USDA-inspected meat, poultry, and seafood entrees, as well as deli-style salads, sandwiches, and wraps. It also manufactures ready-to-eat items spanning plant-based, gluten-free, dairy-free, paleo, vegan, and Whole30 categories, including scratch-cooked grains, proteins, and sauces. A core capability is Modified Atmospheric Packaging (MAP), which extends shelf life through oxygen reduction, gas flushing, gas filling, and heat sealing. Production takes place at the firm's Northern Virginia facilities, though square footage and headcount are not disclosed.

Evermade serves food brands and meal-delivery services, with a highlighted customer being Territory Foods, described as one of the largest locally-sourced healthy meal delivery services in the United States. The company positions itself as a partner for brands seeking to launch or scale products across multiple distribution channels.

Evermade emphasizes reduced minimums and flexible rules to accommodate new ideas, and cites technology for quality, safety, and efficiency as differentiators. The leadership team's direct experience in culinary manufacturing is presented as a guide for clients navigating product development.
